source.title: ANSI Common Lisp HyperSpec — CLASS-OF
source.runtime: SBCL, external Common Lisp donor; not SENS runtime
source.recorded_result: 17/17 historical CLOS slot/object observations passed in #4862

law.statement: Return the class object of which object is a direct instance.
positive_witnesses: For a named standard class C and instance x, CLASS-OF(x) is EQ to (FIND-CLASS 'C).
For an instance of child class CHILD inheriting PARENT, CLASS-OF(x) is the CHILD class object, not the PARENT class object.
CLASS-OF(x) is a class metaobject, not the class-name symbol returned by TYPE-OF for a named standard-class instance.
falsifiers: Return the symbol C rather than the class metaobject.
Return a superclass rather than the direct class.
Return a newly fabricated/non-identical class object instead of the class object for the direct class.

dedup.note: Exact-name absence only routes review; the SBCL observational witnesses are the evidence of difference from TYPE-OF.

ownership.test: Observable class-object identity is language-visible; do not include printer addresses, memory handles, or host ABI identity.
ownership.decision_required: Owner must decide whether the class-object observation is an independent Core law or derivable from selected introspection vocabulary.
